title: Starfleet
connectionLost: Connection to the dashboard lost, retrying...

actions.cleanupConfirm: Clean up this worktree (server + git worktree)?

actionsHelp.open: Open the front-end in a tab
actionsHelp.launch: Create the git worktree (git worktree add)
actionsHelp.stop: Stop the server started by starfleet
actionsHelp.escalate: Flag as blocked — needs a human
actionsHelp.cleanup: Stop the server + remove the git worktree + the row
actionsHelp.track: Register this worktree in starfleet (port, checkpoints, notes)

arch.empty: No architecture defined yet. Agents fill it during the archi step.

files.empty: No file in flight. The tracked worktrees have nothing changed or planned.

fileStatesHelp.touched: Already committed by the branch (git diff base...HEAD)
fileStatesHelp.planned: Declared at the architecture step, not written yet

conflicts.explain: Real conflicts, verified by an in-memory merge (git merge-tree). Starfleet alerts, it never locks.
conflicts.promotedHelp: One side passed a checkpoint: its code stopped moving, so the conflict deserves a task of its own.
conflicts.watchedHelp: Both sides are still writing: visible, not promoted to a task yet.

activity.explain: Activity feed sent by the PostToolUse hook. Only the event is stored, never the content.
activity.empty: No activity received. The hook may not be wired into any repo.

git.untrackedHelp: Worktree present on disk but not registered in starfleet
git.idle: Idle: no event for over 5 minutes
